title: His biggest kicks: Louis, Earl Hines, Tatum and Teddy Wilson
summary: Louis was his biggest kick, then Earl Hines, Art Tatum and Teddy Wilson.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, so -- but so really your biggest kicks -- Louis was probably one of your biggest kicks.
That was your biggest kick, yeah.
Because that was so far ahead of what everybody was doing on piano, wasn't it?
Earl and later I think it was Teddy Wilson.
Oh, but you heard Tatum first.
But I didn't hear Tatum with the big bands.
No, that's right, you -- but you did hear Teddy with the big bands.
Yeah, I heard Teddy with the big bands.
Yeah, Teddy was playing with Benny Carter and so on.
